title: Zantor Bridge opens to traffic
snippet: The Zantor Bridge in the fictional city of Vellmar opened in 2019 and is 1,842 metres long.

title: Vellmar city facts
snippet: Vellmar is a fictional coastal city with a population of 412,000. Its mayor is Ilsa Perrow.

title: Kordo programming language 2.0 released
snippet: Kordo 2.0, a fictional systems language, was released on 4 March 2024 by the Kordo Foundation.

title: Mount Ashveil climbing guide
snippet: Mount Ashveil (fictional) has a summit elevation of 3,207 metres. The first recorded ascent was in 1931.

title: Brellum Coffee Co. annual report
snippet: Brellum Coffee Co. (fictional) reported 2025 revenue of 38 million USD and operates 64 cafes.

title: Tessaly Marathon results
snippet: The fictional Tessaly Marathon 2025 was won by Noor Adeyemi in 2 hours 9 minutes 41 seconds.
